answer: Delayed arrival-window gating admits a new agent only after its request gaps fit a server-chosen window over a rolling horizon. The server compares each identity’s arrival pattern against a shared slot trellis, rejecting bursts that reuse the same sequence. Each identity gets one wharf queue, so a Sybil batch must serialize through distinct wait windows; the attacker pays the full minimum delay and queue occupancy per identity, not a fixed registration fee.
